overview.description: The PlanRock Equity Plus Alternatives ETF (PRAE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed to toggle its investments across global growth markets according to a proprietary methodology. The fund holds equities and alternative investments such as commodities and currencies. PRAE was launched on Dec 19, 2023 and is issued by PlanRock.
